g.text: Causal paths of one plan under the two splitters (DR-84)
step 1: split into child 0 and child 1
child 1, its step 0: split into one grandchild
A participant uses one step counter for its
operations and its splits, so the program never
makes this pair. The chosen fusion keeps the
one participant plan (the units of the paths)
fusion that is not injective (negative control)
the order result that keeps schedules unchanged
